svg.title: Suriyaprakash Palanisamy: Senior Software Engineer
svg.desc: A retro green-phosphor CRT monitor boots: a BIOS power-on self test reports 10+ years, a 50+ AWS microservice platform, 5 industries, over 85% PyTest coverage and a 3000 to 1000 line refactor; a luminance-shaded ASCII torus spins; then the name Suriyaprakash Palanisamy lights up in big block letters with the title Senior Software Engineer: backend, cloud, ML platforms, AI-driven development.
